item.title: Sentosa beach club Tipsy Unicorn closes after High Court winds up operator Tipsy Bird
item.description: Sentosa’s nightlife circuit has lost one of its flashiest players. Tipsy Unicorn has ceased operations after the High Court ordered its operator, Tipsy Bird, to be wound up. According to reports, the court placed Tipsy Bird into compulsory liquidation following a winding-up application filed by United Overseas Bank (UOB) over outstanding debts.
